The 'cutting in' problem is probably the largest source of road rage out there, but the root of the problem has more to do with our perception than actually getting to our destination faster or making traffic move better.

The human instinct is to become agressive and territorial in this situation. Competition and territory defense are burried deep in the brain and hard to fight. But numerous studies have shown that fighting off aggressive jerks trying to cut in causes congestion. The loss of time is letting someone can be measured in seconds, while the congestion caused by fighting for territory causes delays that can slow down thousands.

Bring on the granny cars. The more vehicles that have a rational response rather than an emotional one the better. We will all be safer and move faster as a result.
